title: Microsoft CEO to industry: Software is not going anywhere but changing with AI
content: Satya Nadella has expressed that artificial intelligence will fundamentally change how employees engage with corporate tools. By harnessing AI, software will streamline work processes, minimizing the need to juggle multiple applications. Microsoft is set to introduce Copilot as a universal work OS that seamlessly connects business data. This innovative approach prioritizes customization and integration, offering organizations exciting possibilities to boost operational efficiency.

title: ‘We could have broken more records together’: Kuldeep’s heartfelt message to Chahal
content: In a candid interaction, Kuldeep Yadav opened up about his feelings on surpassing Yuzvendra Chahal's T20I wicket tally. While proud, he wishes to collaborate with Chahal for more unforgettable records. Reflecting on his adaptation to T20 cricket post-hiatus, Kuldeep outlined his game plan for the West Indies, emphasising control and limiting aggressive strokes. Ultimately, he remains focused on the collective success of the team over individual achievements on the field.

title: Jantar Mantar stir: Govt to shut internet for 24hrs within 4km radius in New Delhi
content: Senior Delhi Police officers on Friday also held a high-level meeting at the police headquarters to review the law-and-order situation ahead CJP's proposed protest at Jantar Mantar. The meeting focused on assessing the security situation and reviewing arrangements to maintain law and order in the national capital, they said. Officers also examined recent observations made by the Supreme Court, which are expected to feature in the discussions, sources added.

title: 'POSH is not a Chinese act': Sacked JNU professor alleges 'witch hunt'
content: Angomcha Bimol Akoijam, a Congress MP, was dismissed from JNU after allegations of sexual harassment emerged. The dismissal followed an inquiry where the Internal Committee recommended a major penalty based on the complaints. The allegations alleged inappropriate behavior during classes and interactions with students, leading to significant controversy. Akoijam referred to the dismissal as a potential exposure of a 'witch hunt' against him.

title: Sanju Samson matches Virat Kohli’s record with whirlwind fifty against West Indies
content: In the thrilling second T20I against West Indies, Sanju Samson showcased his batting talent with a blistering fifty, equaling Virat Kohli's record for the fastest fifty by an Indian against this rival. This explosive performance helped propel India's stellar powerplay score in T20Is. Teaming up with Abhishek Sharma, he set a strong foundation for India, continuing their successful momentum after a prior victory in the series.

title: California horse ranch once listed for $109m goes to auction from $20m
content: Rancho Cariñoso, a 4.2-acre oceanfront estate in Carpinteria, has seen drastic price fluctuations since its 2021 listing. Originally priced at $100 million, the value increased before dropping to $48.975 million in 2024. After four years on the market, the estate is now being auctioned with bidding starting at $20 million. The property features direct beach access and a horse trail, appealing to affluent buyers.

title: George Michael secretly paid for woman’s IVF; she gave birth two years later
content: In 2010, George Michael secretly paid for Jo Maidment's IVF treatment after watching her discuss her struggle to conceive on television. Two years later, she gave birth to daughter Betsy. A bouquet of flowers and a card revealed the singer's identity. Maidment publicly shared the story in 2017, following his death.

title: Musk shares 'congratulations message' to fellow recipients as US govt presents medals
content: At the Science: A New Golden Age Summit, the US government honored tech visionaries such as Jensen Huang and Lisa Su with the National Medal of Science. President Donald Trump awarded these distinguished medals, recognizing their exceptional impact on technology and innovation, showcasing the profound influence these leaders have on the fabric of American society and its economy.

title: Dakota Johnson sells renovated LA ‘tree house’ for $5.92M after buying it for $3.55M
content: Dakota Johnson has successfully sold her stunning Los Angeles residence for an impressive $5,924,372, having owned the property since 2016. Initially purchased for $3.55 million amid her burgeoning career, the midcentury home underwent extensive renovations to elevate its charm. Listed at $6 million, it quickly found a buyer, closing a notable chapter in the actress's life.

title: CAFE III kicks in from 2027: Will your next car be cheaper to run?
content: India is set to implement new Corporate Average Fuel Economy norms from April 2027, aiming to enhance fuel efficiency. Automakers will face stricter fuel-consumption targets and incentives for clean technologies, which may impact vehicle prices. Buyers must consider total ownership costs, including maintenance and energy, before purchasing new cars. The regulations will promote various technologies like electric and hybrid vehicles while allowing manufacturers to choose their paths.

title: Brittany Mahomes’ $100M Divi partnership: How is the brand expanding?
content: Patrick Mahomes’ wife Brittany Mahomes reflects on a new update in her career as she collaborates with haircare brand, Divi.

title: Tyreek Hill’s $60,000 claim against Keeta Vaccaro: What happened in court?
content: Tyreek Hill accused his estranged wife, Keeta Vaccaro, of taking $60,000 from their shared family accounts without permission during divorce testimony in Miami on October 8, 2026. Hill claimed she already received substantial monthly support. The allegations followed Vaccaro’s claims that Hill physically assaulted her during pregnancy in 2024. Hill has denied the abuse allegations, while his lawyers challenged her account. The divorce proceedings continue as Hill pursues a possible NFL comeback.

title: South Carolina couple started HVAC firm with $2,000; revenue now set to top $8m
content: A South Carolina couple started an air-conditioning business with just $2,000 after losing their jobs in December 2020. Stephanie and David Postell founded Anchor Heating and Air in 2021, dividing responsibilities between operations and technical services. Nearly five years later, their company is on track to generate more than $8 million in annual revenue.

title: China restaurant owner gifts two employees BMWs worth Rs 43 lakh each
content: In a heartwarming gesture, a restaurant owner in Jiaozuo, China, gifted BMW cars to two dedicated employees struggling with their daily commutes. Ma Yanli, keenly aware of their challenges in tough weather conditions on electric scooters, chose to offer substantial rewards as a recognition of their hard work and commitment. The surprise left the employees overwhelmed with gratitude, showcasing that prioritizing employee well-being fosters a thriving business culture.

title: 'I may share it with Trump': Navi Pillay jokes after winning Nobel Peace Prize
content: Navanethem Pillay was born in Durban during apartheid into a family of Indian Tamil origin. She became a pioneering lawyer and jurist, serving on South Africa's high court before joining the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda. She later served at the International Criminal Court and as the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights.

title: Global warming could enrich Russia but bring NATO closer to its doorstep
content: As the Arctic warms, Russia faces both opportunities and significant challenges regarding its environment and infrastructure. The Northern Sea Route is becoming a vital transit corridor, potentially boosting Russian exports to Asian markets. However, increased traffic raises risks associated with accidents and environmental harm. Despite potential economic benefits, Russia must contend with severe infrastructure damage from permafrost thaw.

title: Why Bangladesh replaced Pakistan at the last minute in Asian Champions Trophy
content: Pakistan has officially withdrawn from the men's Asian Champions Trophy scheduled for late October. Bangladesh will step in as Pakistan's replacement, with matches starting on October 27. The tournament will include major teams like India, Malaysia, and Japan, competing in a round-robin format. India will begin their campaign against Bangladesh after winning the Asian Games gold medal.

title: Utah road plan would blast canyon cliffs; lawsuit says 47 historic sites at risk
content: Conservation organizations have launched a federal lawsuit against a proposed road paving initiative in Utah, citing risks to invaluable historic inscriptions and Native American rock art. Additionally, the project poses a threat to local wildlife, particularly the endangered Mexican spotted owl. The groups claim the US Bureau of Land Management bypassed essential evaluations, illuminating significant concerns surrounding environmental safeguarding and the preservation of cultural heritage.

title: 'Rashid congratulated me': The bond Patekar shared with Pak cricketer nicknamed 'Nana'
content: Latif was himself nicknamed "Nana" after the actor, a connection that former Pakistan cricketer Basit Ali also recalled while paying tribute to Patekar.

title: Travis Kelce's $5.35 million Ohio estate faces dispute over $75,000 sewer bill
content: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion has sparked a growing dispute with neighbors over plans for a six-foot fence and extensive landscaping. Residents have raised concerns about wildlife safety, security and potential damage to a century-old shared sewer pipe, with one neighbor citing a $75,000 repair estimate. Kelce’s construction team says it has made several compromises, but some landscaping proposals remain unresolved following recent planning board discussions.

title: Ohio couple spent $700 building 12-foot backyard roller coaster for their kids
content: An Ohio couple named Jon and Natasha Cain built a roller coaster for their children in 2009. They used local materials and spent approximately $700 on the project, which took three weeks to complete. The roller coaster reached a height of 12 feet and included various twists and turns. Local officials supported their DIY project, allowing it to proceed without issues.

title: UK founder and mother spent £15,000 on vegan supplement; business now turns over £55m
content: A UK mother-son duo spent £15,000 developing a vegan protein supplement before taking up kitchen fitting work to fund their first stock. Founded in 2017, Free Soul has grown into a supplements business with £55 million annual turnover and 50 employees. Its products are now sold through major UK retailers, including Tesco, Boots and Sainsbury's.

title: Texas neighbours fought over 5-foot strip; court upholds easement
content: A dispute between Texas neighbours over a five-foot strip of land near Lake Conroe reached an appeals court after disagreements over utility meters, drainage and property access. The court upheld the Amadors' right to use the neighbouring land for home maintenance and repairs while also confirming a $100 trespass award in favour of the Suitts.

title: Buying arms, selling independence: The strategic cost of importing weapons
content: Global arms sales are increasingly influenced by politics, impacting countries' defense procurement strategies. Many nations, such as India, seek to maintain strategic autonomy amid foreign military dependence. The case of Turkey highlights the risks associated with relying on specific suppliers. India aims to diversify its sources of military equipment while developing domestic manufacturing capabilities. Ultimately, operational independence hinges on managing maintenance and upgrades of advanced weapons systems.

title: Oly quota, medals — no salary: India’s compound archery coach unhappy over pay delay
content: India's compound archers have made landmark strides by attaining the first Olympic quota in their category, thanks to their exceptional performance at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games where they earned three golds and a bronze medal. Despite their triumph, coach Dave Cousins has encountered troubling salary delays, raising issues for the Archery Association of India and the Sports Authority of India.

title: UP’s 10 RS seats filled unopposed: BJP gets 8, SP 2; Akhilesh says ‘focus is on 403’
content: On the last day for withdrawal of nominations, all ten Rajya Sabha candidates from Uttar Pradesh were elected unopposed. The eight BJP candidates include Dharampal Singh and Prakash Pal, while the two candidates from Samajwadi Party are Ram Gopal Yadav and Dhanraj Parimal Nathwani. The BJP introduced an entirely new slate, avoiding renominations of outgoing members in a strategic move.

title: Sisters sought 1/3rd share in parents' property; Madras HC rules in favour of brother
content: In this case, the parents of two daughters and a son owned several properties. The daughters got married and moved to their husbands' homes. On September 10, 2026, the Madras High Court dismissed the sisters' appeal for a share, allowing their brother to retain the land.

title: Russell Peters bought Malibu estate for $4.725m, now asks $8.5m
content: Renowned comedian Russell Peters is making headlines again as he lists his stunning Malibu estate for sale at $8.5 million. After acquiring the property in 2014 for $4.725 million, he has transformed it with substantial renovations. This luxurious home, boasting six bedrooms, offers breathtaking ocean views and an inviting pool, perfect for entertaining.

title: Dennis Quaid cuts asking price of remodeled LA home to $4.6m
content: Dennis Quaid has lowered the price of his Los Angeles mansion from $5.2 million to $4.6 million. He relocated to Nashville with his wife, Laura Savoie, and considers it their primary residence. After buying the Brentwood Hills property for $3.9 million in 2017, Quaid undertook extensive renovations. He expressed dissatisfaction with Los Angeles due to rising taxes and local governance issues.

title: ‘Olympic gold jeetna hai’: Kumkum’s dream after ending Korea’s stranglehold in archery
content: Kumkum Mohod won the women's individual recurve gold medal at the Asian Games. She defeated South Korea’s Oh Yejin in a closely contested final. Kumkum also won gold in the recurve team event and silver in the mixed team event. Her success has secured a quota place for India at the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics. She aims to achieve her ultimate goal of winning Olympic gold in the future.

title: 'Deeply offensive': Govt rebuts Vance’s indentured servants remark
content: the ministry cautioned in its response that the steps announced by the US do not advance the shared ambitions of both countries . the scathing response followed the US announcement about the suspension of many tech companies, including several from India, from the PERM Green Card programme .

title: CJP protest on October 10: SC's order on Delhi restrictions explained in 10 points
content: the bench cautioned that an entire city cannot be shut down in the name of managing a protest . the bench was hearing petitions challenging the proposed closure of 57 metro stations and the cancellation of long-distance trains to the capital .

title: West Bengal bypolls 2026: BJP sweeps Nandigram & Rejinagar; PM Modi hails win
content: BJP candidate hasi Rani Rath polled 1,64,427 votes to defeat Congress candidate Milan Pradhan . saffron party won a thumping majority in west bengal, ending 15-year rule .

title: TVK scores big win in first electoral test, but vote gains raise questions for Vijay
content: chief minister C Joseph Vijay-led Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) cleared its first electoral test barely five months after forming a govt in Tamil Nadu . the ruling party won both seats by fielding former AIADMK MLAs Maragatham Kumaravel and P Sathyabama .

title: 'Anti-monopoly': Rahul seeks level playing field; Musk exchange in focus
content: Rahul Gandhi reiterates his position on corporate concentration and economic structure . he said that each business has a role to play in the Indian economy . his political stance is strictly directed against market monopolies rather than businesses themselves .

title: 'Jo darta hai vo marta hai': Kharge's 'Sholay' slam at govt amid anti-CEC stir
content: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge invoked the iconic dialogue from the 1975 blockbuster "Sholay" he was referring to the sweeping restrictions imposed by the Delhi Police ahead of Saturday's planned protest by youth pressure group Cockroach Janta Party . he remarked: 'they (the government) are scared.'

title: Hours after Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace prize, Trump hits ICC with major sanctions
content: the move marks a significant escalation of the administration’s campaign against the Hague-based court . the sanctions were aimed at preventing the ICC from prosecuting american citizens . president Trump will never allow the international criminal court to prosecute americans .

title: 'Inevitable': AI companies preparing for catastrophic event in 6-12 months
content: executives are gaming out worst-case scenarios, including cyberattacks . a major incident could occur within the next six to 12 months, axios reports . "these scenarios are not treated as inevitable, but are meant to help us prepare," an openAI spokesperson says .

title: 'Nothing can stop India's youth': Chirag on travel curbs ahead of CJP stir in Delhi
content: union minister says 'nothing can stop' the youth of the country . he has also sought to distinguish his position on the ECI from an automatic defence of the ruling establishment . the protest was called by the Cockroach Janta Party at Jantar Mantar on October 10 .
